label.explanation: A template-svc reconciler session opened transaction 80804 on notif-db and left it open holding a row lock on notifications (line 191). Subsequent updates queued behind that lock (lines 208, 219, 225), so template-svc's queries hit their statement timeout and notification-svc's calls to template-svc timed out (lines 209, 211, 232, 233, 242, 244). notification-svc's connection pool to template-svc saturating (lines 243, 265, 271, 279) and the api-gateway 504s (lines 248, 261, 262, 272, 280, 282, 293, 296, 302, 305, 312, 322) are downstream symptoms. The fix is to kill the idle-in-transaction session, not to add capacity. Red herrings: line 202 (a client sending one invalid request, rejected correctly with a 400); line 198 (a single long GC pause in a healthy service, with heap well below limits); line 29 (a routine disk usage warning on the log volume, nowhere near full).
